scope: Bounded image alternative labels for native browser link/button targets, retaining MCP-first routing

stages.accepted: Scoped metadata, local native activation and retained public Search target only. Full movie task and general production browsing remain unaccepted.

policy: Use available verified macOS MCP capabilities first. A missing MCP integration route must be investigated before it becomes a model requirement. This repair does not change routing, model selection, loading, or the 4 GiB production worker cap.
findings: The original model point [968,43] is over the rendered Search img in an anchor. Native metadata before and after eight seconds shows the same image and rectangle, but the baseline catalogue omitted the image-only link.
Two red methods prove the missing alternative-label path in a local page and the real native public page. The local button label is missing as well.
Links and native buttons now fall back to rendered img alternative text only when their existing caption/label is empty. Alternative labels stay separate from rendered text and answer evidence.

Image-label traversal is bounded to 512 descendants, 32 contributing images and 2048 UTF-8 bytes, with existing control (256-byte), link and aggregate page limits. Hidden, inert, editor, zero-size and decorative images do not contribute.

Bindings retain the contributing DOM image nodes. Changed and restored labels or image sources, node replacement and visibility changes reject before native effects. Repeated identical alt assignment still permits two trusted activation cases, on the image and on link padding.

Point rejection diagnostics name only fixed check/field categories; no check was removed or relaxed. The live early retained point rejected changed-hit-layout-opacity. A fresh observation passes immediately and again after eight seconds while the carousel runs.

Three early live diagnostic attempts report XCTest InvalidTransition idle -> failed(deinit); the instrumented attempt locates initial capture / validate-page-stale-agent-content. The tiny probe had bypassed the existing bounded read-only observation retry. Its final form uses the production navigation wrapper, without new retry behavior in production.
All 14 exact current focused methods pass with zero skips. The nine-method regression bundle retains a main-thread responsiveness warning and a QoS priority-inversion warning.

The unchanged real movie task still fails, this time in 96.23 seconds with seven decoded proposals and eight captured observations. The model clicks the sponsored All Concert result and proposes the wrong theroxie.com domain (blocked by the source policy). The eighth proposal attempt fails with invalidResponse before reaching the venue. The current harness retains only successful proposals, so the exact failing request, transport or decode stage is unproved.

This failed full task does not exercise the repaired venue Search target. The independent live preflight proves that narrower capability; it does not establish model accuracy or an end-to-end improvement.
One worker maximum was sampled 214 times and none remained after shutdown. This is not a whole-Mac memory or heat qualification. No ticket selection or purchase was dispatched.
